ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-contrast; approximately 25% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal tips against 75% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region on the left lobe tip containing low-intensity mottling; smaller fragmented high-intensity region on the right lobe tip; central fluke body maintains uniform low-intensity saturation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch; approximately 140-150 degrees; shallow depth relative to total horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serration across the entire upper boundary; left lobe trailing edge displays more jagged, irregular pixel variations compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on both lobes; edges curve outward and upward toward sharp terminal points with a slight distal hook.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several discrete dark circular clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) within the high-intensity white region of the left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Minor dark linear pixel disruptions oriented vertically/radially visible within the high-intensity distal patch on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of small, irregular notches and missing tissue segments along the continuous trailing edge contour.
